title: EWS
summary: A Python repository for early-warning-system (EWS) modeling on bank data, with a synthetic data generation module intended to create synthetic bank records for feature-level augmentation. The module imports multiple SDV single-table and sequential synthesizers (Gaussian Copula, CTGAN, TVAE, CopulaGAN, PAR), but the calling code is entirely commented out, so SDV's synthesizers are only sketched, not confirmed running.
evidence: EWS/analysis/model/syndata.py:1-7 imports SDV synthesizers, but lines 27-70 show only commented-out code invoking them
needs: Cannot confirm whether syndata.py's SDV-based generation function is ever actually invoked elsewhere, since its body is commented out.
